messages:
Sasha: FYI — the postmortem for the inference outage on 2026-03-15 is published. RCA + timeline + mitigations here: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/2026-03-15-inference-outage (internal only). TL;DR: autoscaler race condition + a rare kernel-level OOM on our A100 fleet that caused cascading fallbacks. Root cause and how we fixed it are in the doc. Action items with owners and due dates are listed below. Please read and ack the items you own. :loudspeaker:

postmortem-bot: Document posted by Sasha: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/2026-03-15-inference-outage — summary added to incidents index.

Devon: Thanks — I own the autoscaler fix. Priority: high. I started a draft PR and will target 2026-03-22 for the patch and a small canary rollout. PR: https://code.redwood/infra/prs/4872

Maya: I'll take the cross-region fallback policy work (scope + runbook). Planning to prototype by 2026-03-29. Will add the runbook to the doc.

Emily: Adding observability task for KV-cache eviction metrics + alert thresholds. Will open the monitoring PR today.

Jon: Quick ask — should we change Dedicated rollback policy to immediate fallback-to-l1 in these cases? I left a note in the doc under 'deployment policy'.

Sasha: Good point, Jon. We captured that as Action Item #4 — review rollback policy for Dedicated and Dedicated burst lanes. Owner: Platform policy team (Jon) — due 2026-03-30.

Devon: For transparency, the mitigation we applied during the outage was: 1) blocked new Dedicated scaleups to affected cluster, 2) forced model variant fallbacks on critical routes, 3) manually drained a bad kernel node. Those steps are in the timeline section.

Maya: Can we schedule a 30m checkpoint to verify action-item progress in two weeks? Proposed: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT.

Sasha: Yes — checkpoint scheduled: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Meeting link in the doc. Attendance requested: Devon, Maya, Emily, Jon, Platform leads.

Devon: Acked.

Emily: Acked, will bring monitoring changes to the checkpoint.

Jon: Acked, will bring recommendations for rollback policy.

Sasha: Thanks everyone. If you find missing context or want edits, add them directly to the doc or ping me. We'll track follow-ups as linked issues in the action-items table.
